sentences.text: Taylor Alison Swift -LRB- born December 13 , 1989 -RRB- is an American singer-songwriter .	1989	1989 (Taylor Swift album)
One of the most popular contemporary female recording artists , she is known for narrative songs about her personal life , which has received much media attention .
Born and raised in Pennsylvania , Swift moved to Nashville , Tennessee at age 14 to pursue a career in country music .	Pennsylvania	Pennsylvania	country music	country music
